A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc in the bottom-right corner of the card frame, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 25 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:OTSD-L-arleilschous-PC-Errata-2018-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Arleil Schous (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the 2017 slip. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title; the slip's black strip and “E” are gone and a small round bronze disc sits in the bottom-right corner of the card frame.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the disc card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
